sceneAnimation-name.label: Name
sceneAnimation-name.tip: Animation Name (note: this is a label for user reference only)

sceneAnimation-motion.label: Motion
sceneAnimation-motion.tip: Select an Action in the Animation

sceneAnimation-rotatable.label: Rotatable
sceneAnimation-rotatable.tip: Set to automatically update the Animation's rotation angle

sceneAnimation-angle-box.label: Angle
sceneAnimation-angle-box.tip: Animation's initial angle, affects direction of the action

sceneAnimation-scale-box.label: Scale
sceneAnimation-scale-box.tip: Animation scaling, affects the size of the Animation

sceneAnimation-priority-box.label: Priority
sceneAnimation-priority-box.tip:
Sorting priority of Animation at render time (render layers)
Animations with lower Priority will overlap those with higher Priority
Priority = -1: render position is offset up by one tile
Priority = 1: render position is offset down by one tile

sceneAnimation-conditions.label: Conditions
sceneAnimation-conditions.tip: Set a list of conditions for the Animation to be created; if they aren't met, the Animation isn't created

sceneAnimation-events.label: Events
sceneAnimation-events.tip:
$Animation Events
$Options
Autorun: Event triggers as soon as the Animation appears (including after reading save data)
Custom: triggered using the 'Call Event' command

sceneAnimation-scripts.label: Scripts
sceneAnimation-scripts.tip: Add Script files to extend Animation functions
